exposure: hysteroscopic surgery for cesarean scar syndrome
cohort: 38 women with secondary infertility due to cesarean scar syndrome who underwent hysteroscopic surgery at Shiga University of Medical Hospital between July 2014 and July 2019.
finding: Hysteroscopic surgery is a safe and effective treatment for secondary infertility due to CSS, with the thickness of the residual myometrium potentially influencing subsequent pregnancy.
